# crosswork_te_general_settings (Data Source)

This data source can read the general settings of traffic engineering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_te_general_settings" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `bandwidth_on_demand_provisioning_timeout` (Number) Bandwidth on demand policy provisioning timeout in seconds
- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `igp_path_request_timeout` (Number) IGP path request timeout in seconds
- `policy_details_request_timeout` (Number) Policy and tunnel details request timeout in seconds
- `policy_provisioning_timeout` (Number) Policy and tunnel provisioning timeout in seconds
- `policy_unused_threshold` (Number) Policy unused threshold in kbps
